setup.zh: 溯江往西，江面越来越宽，宽到看不见岸——是云梦泽。芦苇高过人头，风从南边一阵一阵压过来。洞庭那边的天是黑的，已经八十一天了。
setup.en: Up the Jiang westward the river widens until the banks are lost: the Yunmeng Marsh. The reeds stand taller than a man, and the wind comes pressing up from the south in gusts. The sky over Dongting has been black for eighty-one days.

recap.zh: 溯江到了云梦泽；南边洞庭的天，黑了八十一天。
recap.en: Up the Jiang to the Yunmeng Marsh; to the south, the sky over Dongting had been black for eighty-one days.

text.zh: 风暴底下有鼎。它的气被什么吞着——一口一口，吞不完。
text.en: There's a cauldron under the storm. Something is swallowing its breath — mouthful after mouthful, and never done.

alone.zh: 风暴底下有鼎。它的气正被什么一口一口吞着。
alone.en: There is a cauldron under the storm. Something is swallowing its breath, mouthful after mouthful.

text.zh: 撑船的人说：郢都来了使者，正在打听一个带着鼎的人。
text.en: A boatman says: an envoy has come from Ying, asking after someone who carries cauldrons.

exits.means: goes to the city, to Ying, to meet the envoy

text.zh: 你穿过芦苇往西北走。郢都的城门口，一个穿楚服的使者已经等着了。
text.en: Through the reeds north-west. At the gate of Ying an envoy in the dress of Chu is already waiting.

exits.means: asks the boatman about the storm and the lake

text.zh: 他说：风暴一起，湖里就有东西翻身，大得像一座山。有人看见它吐出一堆骨头——是象的。
text.en: He says: when the storm rises something turns over in the lake, as big as a hill. Someone saw it spit out a heap of bones — an elephant's.

text.zh: 吞了象，三年才吐骨头。……是巴蛇。
text.en: Swallows an elephant and gives up the bones three years later. …It's the Ba snake.

alone.zh: 食象，三岁而出其骨——是巴蛇。
alone.en: It eats an elephant and gives up the bones in three years: the Ba snake.

exits.means: goes straight south to Dongting through the storm

text.zh: 你往南走了半日，风把芦苇压平，雨横着打过来，走不动了。
text.en: Half a day south the wind flattens the reeds and the rain comes sideways; you can go no further.

text.zh: 先去郢。那个使者在等你。
text.en: Ying first. That envoy is waiting for you.

alone.en: The wind is too strong. Ying lies north-west.
